findings.finding: The primary label is the common-protocol decoded final valid-molecule affinity, averaged per chemical graph and then equally across graphs for each observed ancestor. Labels are at clock 1.0; coordinate observations cover score times 0.0–0.5, with proposal/control support through 0.51 across 51 events and 14 donor batches.

At score time 0.5, event_support.csv reports 27–35 known descendants per batch and 15–23 censored descendants. The current-to-final Spearman diagnostic ranges from -0.431 to 0.461 across batches (11 positive, 3 negative), so intermediate ranking is heterogeneous and cannot stand in for final quality. The supplied summaries do not provide the two intermediate-rank-by-final-quality strata; I therefore cannot quantify intermediate-high/final-ordinary versus intermediate-ordinary/final-good outcomes here.

The strongest corrected geometry associations are landmark_08_occupancy3 (effect 2.60e-8, q=0.0415) and landmark_08_occupancy5 (effect 5.06e-5, q=0.0415), each evaluated across 14 batches with same-sign effects in 12/14. These are small, hypothesis-generating differences. landmark_08_softmin is directionally opposite (effect -0.01798, q=0.0727; same sign in 12/14) and remains a counter-signal after correction.

The whole-window trends are descriptive temporal curves, not coordinate forces. Displacement RMS has q=0.6004 with same-sign support in 7/14 batches; pair_kernel_5.0 has q=0.2742. These provide no corrected support for a general movement or contact-proxy reward.

rationale: Use decoded-final labels as the target, with coordinate support bounded by the observed score/control windows. The landmark_08 occupancy associations are the only geometry signals below q=0.05 in the supplied outcome evidence, but their small effects, high censoring, survivor-conditioned sampling, and opposing softmin signal make them exploratory hypotheses only. They do not establish a causal coordinate preference or native-continuation benefit.
counterevidence: Mean censored fraction is 0.9043; extinct branches have unknown continuation quality, and clones/descendants are not independent evidence.
Only two occupancy statistics pass q<0.05; the neighboring landmark_08_softmin result has q=0.0727 with an opposing sign, and the displacement statistic is weak (q=0.6004).

Current-to-final ranking diagnostics vary across the 14 batches, including three negative correlations. The available outputs do not resolve the intermediate-high/final-ordinary and intermediate-ordinary/final-good strata, or report a valid-fraction/tail-fraction distribution.
These are retrospective outcomes under Steer selection, not calibrated probabilities under native continuation; the matched-ancestor and descendant-tail extensions were not run.
